title: Make weight part of the API for functions which had default assumptions
description:
As part of https://github.com/networkx/networkx/pull/6688, we found some functions were making assumptions about the `weight` parameter. It was not user programmable and it was defaulting to `weight` the string.

This implements https://github.com/networkx/networkx/issues/6753 and exposes `weight` as part of the API.

comments.author: MridulS
comments.body: This is creating too much diff as I'm also trying to remove the class structures of tests in this PR too. I won't do that for other functions.

review_comments.author: rossbar
review_comments.body:
I think all the other geometric functions defined in the module call `_geometric_edges` internally, so a similar keyword argument would have to be added to them as well. It gets tricky there though because most of them already have a kwarg called `pos`, which is supposed to be a dictionary of positions keyed by node.

Perhaps we should call this something like `position_attr` instead and add it to the rest of the geometric graph generation functions?
